titles.value: 武状元苏乞儿 / King Of Beggars

descriptions.value: 苏乞儿原为贵族，但因上京考武状元时作弊，被眨为乞儿。苏乞儿在机缘巧合下救了丐帮长老，并接任为新帮主。一天，皇上狩猎之时，差点被暗杀，幸苏乞儿及时救驾。皇帝欲恢复其官职时，苏乞儿却拒绝。其后，皇上御赐一个乞儿钵予苏乞儿，从此他过着愉快的行乞生活。
民国初年，富甲一方的康氏惨遭灭门，唯一的目击证人—家中的幼女—在亲眼目睹全家被杀后离奇失踪。几十年间，位于青木巷的废弃康宅充斥着灵异惊悚的气氛。随着真相逐渐揭露，这个恐怖的疑团交织着复仇与死亡的动机。

titles.value: 男与女 / Hong Kong Hong Kong

descriptions.value: 偷渡客孟思晨匿居于山边木屋区，沦为众男工具，期间结识非法拳师江远生，并发生雾水情缘。后来思晨下嫁中年木匠贵叔，生活虽安稳，心灵却空虚。意外再遇远生后，难免干柴烈火，未几更有孕...

titles.value: 摩登仙履奇缘 / Girl with the Diamond Slipper

descriptions.value: 陈七是职业惯匪，偷呃拐骗无所不为，但从不使用暴力；张曼珠是电视台新晋演员，收入微薄，生活拮据。一次偶然中，陈得到了一枚巨钻，欲找买家脱手，却遇杀手追杀，情急下将巨钻藏于某鞋店的一只高跟鞋内，后来，此鞋刚好被张买去参加舞会……
舞蹈教师雪儿年轻貌美，被富商戴家乐力追，但她却喜欢青年艺术家阿化，并与他同居。戴家乐心有不甘，设计让雪儿对他改观，更利诱阿化离开雪儿！

titles.value: 一个人的武林 / Kung Fu Jungle

descriptions.value: 武术教头夏侯武因错手杀人沦为阶下囚，却在狱中敏锐察觉到一场针对全港武林高手的连环杀戮。他凭神准预判命案成功赢得女督察陆玄心的信任，破格出狱协助调查。与此同时，先天残疾却武痴成狂的封于修四处血腥挑战各路宗师。随着杀戮疯狂升级，两位绝世武者终将迎来轰烈对决。
有妇之夫孙子威与莉发展婚外情，其妻宝儿忍无可忍，决定离婚。分居后，宝儿认识一群独身但不甘寂寞的女人，经常聚会，各自各精彩！子威后来发觉自己最爱的依然是宝儿，二人决定复合。怎料在庆祝复合的晚会上，二人经过一场争吵，竟宣布第二度离异...

titles.value: 中华英雄 / A Man Called Hero

descriptions.value: 1913年，华英雄惨遭灭门，愤然流亡美国。妻子洁瑜怀孕寻夫，二人异乡重逢。孰料龙凤胎出生当夜，中华楼遭敌纵火，洁瑜惨死、女婴被掳。十六年后，子华剑雄踏上寻父之路，华英雄则于自由女神像顶，与宿敌无敌展开生死决战。

titles.value: 师兄撞鬼 / Look Out, Officer!

descriptions.value: 该片描述董骠调查制造毒品案，却惨死在毒贩枪下。董骠化做鬼魂回警察局，借警员周星驰之手查清杀己的凶手。冯淬帆和周星驰在茅山老祖的指导下利用灵药合力斗败邪恶法师，枪毙邓公子，为董骠报了仇，使他能安心上天堂。

titles.value: 西游记大结局之仙履奇缘 / Chinese Odyssey2-Cinderella

descriptions.value: 在月光宝盒引发的混乱之后，至尊宝被卷入时空之中，并逐渐觉醒为孙悟空的真实身份。在凡人情感与天命之间不断拉扯，他努力在对紫霞仙子的爱情与肩负的使命之间作出艰难抉择。

titles.value: Live: Finding smart care and rehab solutions at 140th Canton Fair

descriptions.value:
The 140th China Import and Export Fair, also known as the Canton Fair, is underway in Guangzhou, south China, showcasing high-tech care and rehabilitation devices, from exoskeletons to stair-climbing wheelchairs. 
Millions of people worldwide need care and rehabilitation, and many can't afford it or reach it. CGTN's Zheng Songwu visits the fair's dedicated zone to test the latest devices and speak with international buyers about how China is helping meet that demand.

The Token Economy
Demand for AI tokens is surging, with trends like “tokenmaxxing” accelerating the race for computing power.
As pressure mounts on computing and energy infrastructure, China is leveraging its clean energy strengths to support AI growth, while “token exports” emerge as a new way to deliver AI services to global users.
What’s the future like for the “token economy”? Join us on BizTalk as we explore the economics behind the AI revolution.

titles.value: Live promo: Small products, big industry: Meet the Canton Fair's manufacturing 'hidden champions'

descriptions.value: At the 140th Canton Fair on Saturday, CGTN reporter He Jingyi joins Johann Anton Klimmer, a German tool importer and longtime Canton Fair buyer, to explore specialized sectors ranging from hardware and tools to precision components, general machinery, and lighting and electrical products. What can seemingly ordinary products tell us about the strength of a much larger industry?

titles.value: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions

descriptions.value:
In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how?
Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

titles.value: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time

descriptions.value: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

titles.value: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life

descriptions.value:
Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art.
In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

descriptions.value:

In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

descriptions.value: Today, we continue with our new series "All the Lives We Live," spotlighting five young Chinese people who are breaking the mold. They've taken unconventional paths, excel at what they do, and infuse passion and personality into every step. In their own way, they're redefining what it means to be young-and promising-in today's China. In this episode, we meet Xu Mengran. Xu leads a double life as both a textbook editor and a Peking Opera enthusiast. Let's see how this unique balance of logic and art fuels her creativity and pushes the boundaries of what it means to be successful.

Tianran and Hannah are in Shantou, Guangdong Province in south China, where they drink more tea than anywhere else in the country. They'll savor the complex aroma of the curiously named "Duck Poo Fragrance" tea, as well as enjoy a more traditional "yum cha" breakfast. They get a taste of traditional handicrafts, from breaking bowls to make inlaid porcelain to rolling "kueh" rice cakes, and feast on everything from sweet and savory street snacks to the finest seafood dining.

Tianran and Hannah are in the picturesque city of Shaoguan in Guangdong Province, South China. They try tea grown on Danxia landforms and feast on mountain produce, before getting hands-on with making rice noodles in a Hakka walled village. They learn about the Hakka people's southward migration and the effect it had on local tea and food, and end their journey in a thousand-year-old Buddhist temple, seeing how the monks integrate their practice into everyday life, and discovering just why tea is so important to Zen.
